contract: Real import must be impossible unless a future controlled executor explicitly exposes and receives this flag.
Operator must type an exact confirmation phrase tied to run_id/archive hash.
Reviewer and approver must be present, distinct, and recorded in the import summary.
DSN value must come from environment/secret store and must not be serialized into repository artifacts.
The real executor must consume reviewed artifacts by explicit path and reject mutable run-folder discovery.
